common_sections: Exact API and tool introspection protocol
Resolved guidance conflicts and stale-source traps

HST.focus: Projection and actual provider attempts: immutable snapshots/copy semantics; explicit source order; context/cancel/join; preserve signed wire segments, per-attempt admission and existing Fantasy APIs.

STO.focus: Existing SQLite/sqlc and authoritative Tx ownership; parameter values, Rows.Err/Close, checked commit, flush outside Tx, real driver isolation/ambiguous commit, exact generated artifacts.

CAP.focus: Earliest byte capture; n>0 before err, short writes/flush/close, quotas and rooted paths, subprocess descendants/platform cancellation; preserve native exit and representation.

REC.focus: Exact query/encoding and range contracts; bound FTS fallback/cursors and literal syntax; scope before ranking and expansion; real DB and malformed cursor/parser fuzz evidence.

MEM.focus: Attributed immutable evidence, typed state and time; background ownership/stop, explicit egress, real transaction/invalidation and stale publication tests.

HIE.focus: Concrete ordered hierarchy and hysteresis; runtime timer semantics, budgeted worker admission, durable rollover fences and source authorization, representative measurement.

VEC.focus: Bound vectors/top-k, deterministic ties, numeric/NaN/encoding and generation policy; selected PG/pgvector/embedding contracts; real DB, revocation, performance evidence.

HEL.focus: Restricted helper/MCP capabilities; bounded HTTP/stream/JSON, read-only authority, cancellation and joins, selected MCP protocol/transport, preserve native tool permission.

PRV.focus: Provider SDK/model/cache wire and retries: exact selected adapter, replayability and cancellation, actual attempt/output escape, preserve v1 wire and measure usage not estimated hits.

PER.focus: Live origin grant/revocation, archive/path/expansion limits, exact JSON presence/encoding, credentials and authorization, idempotent export/import and fail-closed offline behavior.

DST.focus: Selected PG/RabbitMQ delivery/ack/lease/fence/outbox and commit ambiguity; lifecycle, bounded admission, real restart/partition/restore tests and reproducible service versions.

REW.focus: Exact root/path/mode/link/rename/durability semantics per OS; write intents, filesystem/DB receipt, recovery ownership and checked compensation, preserve dirty/staged work.

OPS.focus: Preserve Cobra/Bubble Tea/workspace config; typed DTO/JSON old-new compatibility, status/stdout/stderr, scoped endpoints, lifecycle and canonical schema generator.

QA.focus: Independent selected-version evidence, real boundaries not mocks, target matrix and reproducibility, scoped fuzz/race, generated drift and vulnerability finding gate; no fabricated pass.
